scope: Contact onsets from saved rigid poses with exact scene outlines, calibrated on training/validation simulator references; no model, threshold or recorded score changes.
onset_rule: interval i: outlines separated at frame i and within the touch threshold at frame i+1
held_out_scope: Descriptive only: frozen D018 checkpoints and plans, touch threshold chosen on training clips before reading them; no selection or gate.

limitations: Exact outlines come from the scene specification: evaluation-only ground truth, as labels are.
Circles and rectangles only; triangles occur only in the shape-OOD split.
Frame-sampled poses cannot see onsets that begin while objects already touch.
Validation first-contact timing uses eight collision conditions; held-out D018 adds twenty on ten fresh ID scenes.
